description.subtitle: Real Betis Balompié Hummel long training pants 2026 2027 - green
description.tagline: Entrena con la intensidad del Betis
description.intro: The Hummel Betis Core 2.0 training pants are part of the official Real Betis Balompié training collection for the 2026-2027 season. Designed to offer comfort, freedom of movement and a sporty fit, it is the ideal garment to prepare for each session with the same equipment used by the green and white team.
key_benefits: Official Real Betis design: Training pants for the 2026 2027 season.
Comodidad en movimiento: Corte deportivo que favorece la movilidad.
Light and breathable fabric: Helps maintain comfort even during the highest intensity sessions.
Secure fit: Elastic waist with adjustable drawstring for a comfortable and personalized fit.
